% Resistive Alfvén dispersion
\begin{equation}\label{eq:F4_disp}
\omega^2 + i\,\eta\,k^2\,\omega - v_A^2 k^2 = 0,\qquad v_A = B_{r,0}/\sqrt{\rho_0}
\end{equation}

% Weak-resistivity expansion (outgoing branch)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:F4_weak}
\omega = v_A k - \tfrac{i}{2}\,\eta\,k^2 + \mathcal{O}(\eta^2),\qquad \varepsilon_{\mathrm{weak}} \equiv \eta k / v_A \ll 1
\end{equation}

% Amplitude decay rate
\begin{equation}\label{eq:F4_decay}
A(t) = A_0 \exp(-\gamma\,t),\qquad \gamma = \tfrac{1}{2}\,\eta\,k^2
\end{equation}

% Numerical resistivity (2nd-order Godunov modified-equation)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:F4_eta_eff}
\eta_{\mathrm{eff}}(h) = C_{\mathrm{num}}\,h^2\,v_A,\qquad \gamma_{\mathrm{num}}(N) = \tfrac{1}{2}\,C_{\mathrm{num}}\,h^2\,v_A\,k^2 \propto N^{-2}
\end{equation}

% Two-resolution scheme-order inversion
\begin{equation}\label{eq:F4_order}
p = \frac{\log(\gamma_1/\gamma_2)}{\log(N_2/N_1)},\qquad \text{expect } p \approx 2\text{ for 2nd-order scheme}
\end{equation}

% Test-pass criteria (A4 CPAW long-time)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:F4_pass}
|p_{\text{measured}} - 2| < 0.3\quad \text{AND}\quad A(t=50\,T)/A(0) \in [0.1, 1]\quad \text{for all }N
\end{equation}
